Cara L.: FYI incoming PO from Meadowlark (PO#52341) — partner getting "attachment rejected" in marketplace portal. They say their ERP emits UTF-16 XML. Can procurement/finance advise?
invoice-bot: Inbound PO 52341 scanned. status=attachment_rejected, reason=encoding_mismatch, content_type=application/xml; charset=UTF-16. Reference: ticket#MLK-847
Ravi P.: Can we accept UTF-16 for now or do we need partner to re-emit UTF-8? Procurement needs a workaround to avoid delaying launch.
Mei Chen: Finance: our ingestion pipeline expects UTF-8. Parser fails on BOM. We can accept manual conversion but need audit trail + checksum. Quick tech fix: use `iconv -f UTF-16 -t UTF-8` during ingest.
Jordan (Legal): Legal note: changing file encoding is fine operationally, but we must ensure the PO hash still matches the signed doc. No contractual term change. Add a metadata flag capturing original encoding.
Alex @ Meadowlark: Sorry about that — our ERP exports legacy UTF-16. We can flip to UTF-8 but it takes ~24h change window. We need the transaction to clear sooner. Is a temporary manual ingest acceptable?
Cara L.: Proposal: ops runs a one-off conversion to UTF-8, attach `original_charset=UTF-16` to PO metadata, log the checksum, and then proceed. If legal + finance sign off, we do it.
Ravi P.: Procurement ok with manual ingest provided partner confirms PO number & signatory. Alex, can you confirm the signer on this PO matches DocuSign?
Alex @ Meadowlark: Confirmed — signer is Dana Morales (dana@meadowlark.com). DocuSign envelope #7892 matches PO#52341.
Mei Chen: Finance approves conditional ingest. I'll create GL mapping: `rev_code=5003`, and will record transformation step in ledger. Need ops to add a note in the PO metadata and produce pre/post checksums.
Jordan (Legal): Legal approves conditional ingest under these controls: 1) record `original_charset=UTF-16`, 2) store original attachment in archive, 3) document chain-of-custody.
Mej Ops: Mej Ops here — we can stand up a temp S3 bucket + Lambda to convert and push to the portal. Command we plan to run: ```iconv -f UTF-16 -t UTF-8 /tmp/po.xml > /tmp/po-utf8.xml && sha256sum /tmp/po-utf8.xml > /tmp/po-utf8.sha256``` ETA 3 hours after test file. Need a sample upload to `s3://redwood-temp-ingest/52341/test.xml`.
Cara L.: Uploading sample now (sanitized). `po-52341-sample-utf16.xml` — please confirm once you pick it up.
Mej Ops: Got it. Starting a dry run now. Will post results in thread.
invoice-bot: Note: ingestion_event recorded, correlation_id=mlk-52341-0a7f.
Mej Ops: Dry run successful. Converted file validated, pre/post checksums attached. Pushed to staging portal path.
Mei Chen: Received checksums and GL entry created. Finance marks as approved for payment processing after final QA.
Jordan (Legal): Archive of original attached to contract folder and DocuSign cross-ref updated. Legal closing sign-off.
Cara L.: Great — thanks team. I'll draft a 1-paragraph runbook for partnerships KB and update Meadowlark onboarding checklist with the charset note. Closing this internal thread after I've posted the runbook. :white_check_mark:
